name: support-service

scripts.test:unit: NODE_ENV=test tsx tests/unit/sla-engine.unit.test.ts && NODE_ENV=test tsx tests/unit/auth-and-admin-guards.unit.test.ts && NODE_ENV=test tsx tests/unit/schemas-and-validation.unit.test.ts && NODE_ENV=test tsx tests/unit/idempotency.unit.test.ts

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
